lines.en: I paddle slowly with my webbed arms.
Deep water presses on my soft body.

lines.zh: 我披着腕膜，像一片黑影。
lines.en: Wrapped in my arm-web, I drift like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我往暗处游，躲开大影子。
lines.en: I swim toward the dark, away from big shadows.
The current pushes and I drift with it.
My tentacles trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，一点一点挪。
lines.en: I creep along the rock wall, bit by bit.
A shark passed through here just now.
I pull my arms in and speed up.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有方向，只有水。
lines.en: In the dark there is only water, no direction.

lines.zh: 我吐出一道水，往前一冲。
lines.en: I shoot a jet of water and lunge forward.

lines.zh: 岩壁边有条窄缝，我钻过去。
lines.en: A narrow crack by the rock; I slip through.
My soft body does not mind being squeezed.
I drift into a colder layer of water.
I spread my arms into a net.

lines.zh: 冷水流过我的鳃，很舒服
lines.en: Cold water passes my gills; it feels good.

lines.zh: 我在礁石背面等水变暗
lines.en: I wait on the far side of the reef for the water to darken.

lines.zh: 我翻个身，肚皮朝上漂走
lines.en: I roll over and drift away belly up.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，滤着水里的细末。
lines.en: I open my mouth and filter the tiny bits.

lines.zh: 腕膜张开来像一件斗篷。
lines.en: My arm-web spreads like a cloak.
I stay still and let the water pass.
Plankton bumps against my mouth.
I blink once, slowly.
There is faint light in the dark; I see it.

lines.zh: 我把触须卷成一个小圈。
lines.en: I curl my tentacles into a small loop.

lines.zh: 水压让我的身子有点胀。
lines.en: The pressure makes my body swell slightly.
I have eaten nothing, and I am in no hurry.
I rest against the rock wall a while.

lines.zh: 上方有个大家伙的影子。
lines.en: A big shadow moves above me.
I let out a slow string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 我的腕足自己轻轻摆动。
lines.en: My arms sway on their own, softly.

lines.zh: 深水里静得只剩我的划水声。
lines.en: The deep is silent but for my paddling.
You carry a light, and it stings my eyes.
I watch you from behind my arm-web.
Are you a fish, or something else?
I drift back a little, slowly.
Your breathing sounds loud underwater.

lines.zh: 我不认识你这种大个子。
lines.en: I do not know big creatures like you.
Do not reach out; I will jet away.
Your lamp shows my dark red skin.
I stare at you with my mouth still open.
Will you eat me? I taste bad.
My arm-web is torn in one place.
My soft body took a hit; it hurts.
I squirt out a cloud of dark water.
One of my tentacles is shorter now.
I curl up and sink.

lines.zh: 这一下差点把我的腕膜打散。
lines.en: That nearly tore my arm-web apart.
My red skin is broken and water stings in.
My escape is a clumsy one.

lines.zh: 谁在暗处打我？我看不清。
lines.en: Who strikes me in the dark? I cannot see.
I need to hide in a rock crack.

lines.zh: 水里那些细末在往这边飘。
lines.en: Those tiny specks are drifting this way.
That is the smell of plankton.
I open my mouth and drift closer.
This cloud will keep me filtering a while.

lines.zh: 你撒的东西在水里散开。
lines.en: What you scattered spreads in the water.
I do not bite; I only filter.

lines.zh: 我的腕足已经伸过去了。
lines.en: My arms have already reached toward it.
Stop swinging the lamp; I cannot see my food.
This smell makes me forget the sharks.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点就能吃到了。
lines.en: One more drift and I can feed.
You scatter the water around me.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻过来，腕膜朝天。
lines.en: I am knocked over with my arm-web up.

lines.zh: 我的腕足缠到你身上了。
lines.en: My arms are tangled on you.

lines.zh: 软身子撞上去不疼，可我怕。
lines.en: My soft body takes no hurt, but I am afraid.
I curl into a ball and roll away.
Your knee shoves me aside.
I jet water and pull back.
Part of my tentacle is pinned.
Do not squeeze; my arm-web will tear.
After the bump I hide in the rock crack.
I spread my arm-web for you to see.
Let us swim into the dark together.
Your tentacles are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 水里的微光够我们用了。
lines.en: The faint light in the water is enough for us.
I press close and paddle slowly.

lines.zh: 你游得太快，我的腕足追不上。
lines.en: You swim too fast; my arms cannot follow.
This rock crack is ours.
I open my mouth at you; it is a kindness.
When sharks come, we hide together.

lines.zh: 你身上的颜色和我一样。
lines.en: Your color is the same as mine.
I wrap an arm around this thing.

lines.zh: 它比浮游生物大太多了。
lines.en: It is far bigger than plankton.
I hold it and swim slowly.
Can I eat this? Let me sniff first.
What fell is mine now.
I hold it with two tentacles.
It is so heavy I almost sink.
I tuck it under the rock wall.
My soft mouth cannot crack this shell.
I curl around it and spin once.

lines.zh: 前面有一小团浮游生物。
lines.en: A small cloud of plankton is ahead.
A few small shrimp are clustered together.
That cloud is drifting slowly.
I open my mouth and aim at it.

lines.zh: 这不是鲨鱼，我可以靠近。
lines.en: That is no shark; I can approach.
My arms reach out first.

lines.zh: 那团细末还没察觉我靠近。
lines.en: That cloud has not noticed me closing in.
One small mouthful is enough.
I fix on the thickest part of the cloud.
The target is close; I need not chase.
I drift along after that cloud.
It scatters, so I turn another way.
My mouth stays open the whole time.

lines.zh: 流把它推向左，我也向左。
lines.en: The current pushes it left; I go left too.
I slowly draw my arms in.
It is only one arm's length away.
I am in no rush; filtering takes patience.
A few shrimp are mixed in that cloud.
I swing around the stone and keep following.
It drifts closer and closer to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的腕足一下子裹住它。
lines.en: My arms wrap around it all at once.
I drag it to my mouth.
It thrashes inside my arm-web.
I do not bite; I swallow it whole.
The small hooks on my tentacles prick it.
This grip is tight.
It breaks free once; I wrap it again.

lines.zh: 我腕足不壮，裹住你却够了。
lines.en: My arms are weak, but enough to hold you.
The fight ends; I filter water again slowly.
Do not blame me; I have to eat.

lines.zh: 水里忽然多出我这一团。
lines.en: Suddenly there is one more of me in the water.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己从哪来的。
lines.en: I do not know where I came from.
I open my eyes to deep water and no light.
First I try spreading my arm-web.
There is no other of my kind here.
I should head somewhere darker.
The water is cold; my skin tightens.

lines.zh: 我一出生就张着嘴滤水。
lines.en: I filter water with open mouth from birth.
First find a rock crack and hide.

lines.zh: 上面有鲨鱼影子，我下沉。
lines.en: A shark shadow above; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我的腕足蜷起。
lines.en: Hot water curls my arms up.
I fall from the water onto hard ground.
Away from water, my body dries out.

lines.zh: 炸响震得我的腕膜发麻。
lines.en: The blast numbs my arm-web.
An arrow passes through my arm-web.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进我软软的身子。
lines.en: Strange force crawls through my soft body.

lines.zh: 水里没有细末，我空着嘴。
lines.en: No specks in the water; my mouth stays empty.

lines.zh: 雷顺着海水下来，我的牙都麻。
lines.en: Lightning comes down the sea and numbs my fangs.
I fall into blackness with no water.
